title: SPRUNN: Structural Proximity for Pruning in Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.32317v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. Furthermore, we integrate this approach with fine-grained pruning in Fully Connected(FC)layers

translated_title: SPRUNN：用于深度神经网络剪枝的结构接近度方法
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在各类机器学习任务中展现出了显著的准确率。然而，这些网络存在参数量和计算量巨大的问题，导致处理过程非常耗时。因此，参数剪枝方法被提出用于压缩深度神经网络并实现高效部署。剪枝的主要挑战在于选择合适的剪枝参数，同时不显著损害模型准确率。本文提出了SPRUNN，一种基于结构接近度准则的算法剪枝方法，用于深度神经网络卷积层中的滤波器剪枝。结构接近度（SP）通过考虑所有滤波器并将每个滤波器与其他滤波器进行比较来计算滤波器相似度，从而有效识别卷积层中较不重要的滤波器进行剪枝。此外，我们将该方法与全连接层中的细粒度剪枝相结合。
tldr: 本文提出基于结构接近度准则的滤波器剪枝方法SPRUNN，通过全面比较滤波器间的相似性识别并剪除不重要的滤波器，并与全连接层细粒度剪枝相结合，在不显著损失准确率的前提下压缩深度神经网络。
